items.title: Dave S. Oxley Sr. Interview, 1965-01-06
items.q: we had another girl, I used to sing most of the pop tunes, they called Annette Bailey

ctx.x: And you know, some pop songs, I mean, she sang.

Because, you see, we had another girl, I used to sing most of the pop tunes, they called Annette Bailey, a girl from Birmingham, Alabama. She was a nice singer too. I haven't, I don't know what happened to her, Annette, but she was a nice singer too.
